scope: API configuration and published-rate estimation; no task quality measurement

openai.continuation: Stateless input history with reasoning.encrypted_content, required by this organization's Zero Data Retention policy

gemini.usageAccounting: Interactions total_output_tokens excludes total_thought_tokens; the cumulative attempt budget and estimate include both

tokenization.provenance: Each exact text hash, provider response hash, count, status, request ID where provided, and timestamp is retained in evaluation/contexts/tokenization/

limitations: Provider model identifiers and the available version metadata are recorded; hosted weights are not controlled by the laboratory.
Reasoning settings and tokenizer units differ between providers. Comparisons are stratified by model and language.
Cost figures are estimates at the published standard text rates, not invoices. Unreported cache-write billing and failed-call charges may differ; unpriced calls are retained.
Binding qualification failures are preserved separately from the 600 scheduled study attempts. They do not count as task results.
